verification_notes: Context: WebSearch budget for the session was exhausted (200/200), so the verification relied on WebFetch and curl of datan.fr roll-call pages and the French Wikipedia article. Unsourced party_line codes I could not open evidence for are kept as-is and still unverified.

int1: +2 low party_line no source -> +2 medium vote: Faure personally voted POUR on the 12 Mar 2025 Ukraine support resolution (datan vote_988) and the 12 Mar 2024 Ukraine aid declaration (vote_3461).

int3: -2 -> -1 (inferred): the cited Wikipedia passage says PS cadres challenged Faure over the NUPES deal's NATO-exit clause. It is not Faure's own opposition. The only evidence is a pro-NATO group vote (Sweden/Finland accession 2022, vote_184), and nothing covers the integrated command specifically.

ecol1: -2 low vote no source -> -2 medium vote with sources: the group voted CONTRE abolition on 28 May 2025 (vote_2190) and POUR keeping ZFE as optional on 14 Apr 2026 (vote_6183). Faure is not individually listed on either vote. Added a nuance on the softening.
ecol2: +2 low -> +2 medium: Faure's own CONTRE votes on the Duplomb law (vote_2957, 8 Jul 2025) and on the acetamiprid reauthorisation (vote_8427, 20 Jul 2026) are confirmed.

ene1: +1 party_line -> -1 low vote: the datan raw page shows Faure voted CONTRE the 21 Mar 2023 nuclear acceleration law (vote_1243, six EPR target). The claim that PS supports reactors beyond 6 EPR2 had no evidence.

ene2: -2 -> null: the Wikipedia citation was misattributed (the anti-EPR-dismantling objection came from cadres criticising Faure). Faure signed NUPES and voted against the 2023 nuclear law, so his current position is unclear. Note that a WebFetch summary of datan wrongly reported a POUR vote, and a raw curl check corrected it.
ins4: +2 -> +1: Wikipedia records that Faure accepted in late January 2026 that the government use 49.3 to pass the budget, which contradicts a strong abolition stance. Added the source.
soc1: +2 low vote no source -> +2 high vote: Faure voted POUR at the final reading on 15 Jul 2026 (vote_8280; group 57-4-6).
soc3: -1 inferred -> -2 low vote: Faure voted CONTRE banning religious signs and the veil in universities (vote_3352, Feb 2021). This is an old vote and the school-trip parents part is unverified.
san1: +1 kept and source added (vote_1812, the 2023 Garot amendment to regulate doctors' installation). It is a weaker version than mandatory posting, and Faure's own vote is not listed.
int7: summary amended to mention the adjacent 2025 vote calling for seizing Russian assets; code unchanged.

Unverified and unchanged because no live evidence was retrievable: int2, int4, int5, int6, ecol3, ecol4, ecol5, ene3, ene4, ins1, ins2, ins3, ins5, soc2, soc4, soc5 (null kept), edu1-edu5, san2, san3, san4. The +/-2 party_line codes among them (int4, ecol4, ene3, ins2, soc2, soc4, edu2, edu3, edu4, san2, san3, san4) rest on background knowledge only and should be re-checked once the search budget is raised.
